_README: Bus stops by explicit world coordinates. EMPTY on purpose.
The five bridge stops and the Gangjung control that used to live here were
scaffolding from before BusStop_* meshes worked. Stops are placed in the
editor now: name a mesh BusStop_Old_Harbour and it becomes a station where
it stands, which is both fewer coordinates to keep in sync and the only way
the name and the position can never disagree.
Entries here still work if a stop ever needs placing without an editor pass.
